title: Retro Synthwave Album Cover
coreRelationships: The glowing grid and neon triangles create a sense of depth and perspective.
The text elements are layered and styled with gradients and outlines to stand out against the dark background.
The starry background provides a cosmic, infinite feel that contrasts with the structured grid.
The color palette is dominated by purples, pinks, and blues, characteristic of the synthwave genre.
The different font styles and sizes establish a clear hierarchy among the textual information.
reuseFormula: Recreate a dark, starry background with a blue-purple gradient. Overlay a glowing, receding grid at the bottom. Add neon geometric shapes (e.g., triangles) in the mid-ground. Place three lines of text: the top in a script font with a pink glow, the middle in a large, bold, blocky font with a metallic gradient and red outline, and the bottom in a smaller, blocky font with a bright blue glow. Ensure all elements maintain a vibrant, high-contrast neon aesthetic.
